title: Towards Lexical Gender Inference: A Scalable Methodology using Online Databases
reasoning: The paper focuses on a methodology for lexical gender inference to detect gender bias in NLP. Although it includes a 'religion' category in its gold standard dataset with words such as 'nun', 'monk', and 'friar', these are used as lexical examples of gendered nouns rather than as a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
